text: Oil benchmarks exceed $100 per barrel following Strait of Hormuz closure and regional production cuts. Asia-Pacific equity indices decline sharply; Kospi triggers circuit breaker and trading suspension. Semiconductor equities fall across South Korea and Japan. Market volatility rises as energy supply disruption becomes visible within pricing and trading activity.

meta.note: Oil remained elevated despite partial Saudi supply release; classification balanced between compression and exposure.

text: China CPI rises 1.3% year-over-year, the largest increase since 2023. Core CPI reaches 1.8%. Producer price index remains negative but deflation slows to -0.9%, the shallowest decline in over a year. Commodity and metals pricing increases appear in factory-gate inputs while consumer prices show upward movement during the reporting period.

meta.note: Holiday consumption surge creates temporary demand signal; persistence unclear within snapshot classification.

text: Novo Nordisk withdraws patent litigation against Hims & Hers following an agreement allowing distribution of Ozempic and Wegovy through the telehealth platform. Hims ceases advertising compounded GLP-1 drugs and limits compounding to rare cases. Hims shares rise sharply during trading following announcement of the arrangement.

meta.note: Large price movement present but treated as market response, not separate financial infrastructure event.
